passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my bicycle, and it has two wheels.
phrases.ko: 이것은 나의 자전거이고, 바퀴가 두 개 있어요.
phrases.zh: 这是我的自行车，它有两个车轮。
phrases.py: zhè shì wǒ de zì xíng chē， tā yǒu liǎng gè chē lún。

phrases.en: I wear a helmet, and I ride to the park.
phrases.ko: 나는 헬멧을 쓰고, 공원까지 자전거를 타요.
phrases.py: wǒ dài tóu kuī， qí chē qù gōng yuán。

phrases.en: I do not ride too fast, and I stay safe.
phrases.ko: 나는 너무 빨리 타지 않고, 안전하게 타요.
phrases.zh: 我骑得不太快，我注意安全。
phrases.py: wǒ qí de bù tài kuài， wǒ zhù yì ān quán。

phrases.en: The bell rings when people are near.
phrases.zh: 人靠近的时候，铃声会响。
phrases.py: rén kào jìn de shí hòu， líng shēng huì xiǎng。

phrases.en: A helmet keeps my head safe.
phrases.ko: 헬멧은 내 머리를 안전하게 해 줘요.
phrases.zh: 头盔保护我的头，让我安全。
phrases.py: tóu kuī bǎo hù wǒ de tóu， ràng wǒ ān quán。

phrases.en: I ride with my brother on Saturday.
phrases.zh: 星期六我和哥哥一起骑车。
phrases.py: xīng qī liù wǒ hé gē gē yì qǐ qí chē。

phrases.en: We stop at the park and rest.
phrases.py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán tíng xià xiū xī。

phrases.en: Fast is not safe, so I ride slowly there.
phrases.ko: 빠른 것은 안전하지 않아서 나는 거기서 천천히 타요.
phrases.zh: 太快不安全，所以我在那里慢慢骑。
phrases.py: tài kuài bù ān quán， suǒ yǐ wǒ zài nà lǐ màn màn qí。

phrases.en: My bicycle is fun, and I take care of it.
phrases.ko: 나의 자전거는 재미있고, 나는 자전거를 소중히 다뤄요.
phrases.zh: 我的自行车很有趣，我会好好爱护它。
phrases.py: wǒ de zì xíng chē hěn yǒu qù， wǒ huì hǎo hǎo ài hù tā。

full_passage_spoken: This is my bicycle, and it has two wheels. It has a bell. I wear a helmet, and I ride to the park. I do not ride too fast, and I stay safe. It is fun. The bell rings when people are near. A helmet keeps my head safe. I ride with my brother on Saturday. We stop at the park and rest. Fast is not safe, so I ride slowly there. My bicycle is fun, and I take care of it.
full_passage_zh: 这是我的自行车，它有两个车轮。它有铃声。我戴头盔，骑车去公园。我骑得不太快，我注意安全。这很有趣。人靠近的时候，铃声会响。头盔保护我的头，让我安全。星期六我和哥哥一起骑车。我们在公园停下休息。太快不安全，所以我在那里慢慢骑。我的自行车很有趣，我会好好爱护它。
